hooks.name: Require test update for core logic and schemas
hooks.description: After the agent saves a .ts file under packages/core/src/, confirm that the mirrored unit and property tests are updated. Schema changes also need the schema and property tests.

action.prompt: A file under packages/core/src/ was just saved. Confirm that the mirrored tests in packages/core/test/ are updated for this change: for packages/core/src/<name>.ts they are <name>.test.ts and <name>.pbt.test.ts (and any other *.pbt.test.ts file whose name starts with <name>). If the saved file is packages/core/src/schemas.ts, the tests that must cover the change are schemas.test.ts, snapshot-roundtrip.pbt.test.ts and faa-body.pbt.test.ts. If a mirrored test is missing or does not cover the change, write or update it now. If you cannot confirm coverage, stop and tell the user why.
